rules.description: HCPs must provide explicit, informed consent before any marketing communication. Silence or pre-ticked boxes do not constitute consent.
rules.implementation: Consent Management must be configured as opt-in by default. No communication channels enabled without explicit consent record.
rules.penalty: Up to 4% of annual global turnover or €20 million, whichever is higher

rules.description: HCPs can request deletion of all personal data. Must be actioned within 30 days.
rules.implementation: Data deletion workflow must cascade across all modules: Account, Visit History, Sample Transaction History, Email History, Consent Records. Anonymization is acceptable alternative for regulatory-required records (e.g., sample audit trails).

rules.description: HCPs can request their data in a machine-readable format.
rules.implementation: Export capability must cover: personal data, consent history, interaction history. Format: CSV or JSON. Response time: 30 days.

rules.description: Each data processing activity must have a documented lawful basis (consent, legitimate interest, legal obligation, etc.).
rules.implementation: Custom field or metadata on each module to record lawful basis. Consent module tracks consent-based processing; separate documentation for legitimate interest processing.

rules.description: Maintain records of all processing activities (Article 30).
rules.implementation: Enable Field Audit Trail for all modules processing personal data. Retain audit logs for minimum 5 years.

additional_rules: Bundesdatenschutzgesetz (BDSG) adds restrictions on employee data processing
Works council (Betriebsrat) may need to approve CRM data processing
Stricter interpretation of legitimate interest — lean toward explicit consent
CNIL requires specific cookie consent mechanisms
Transparency Code (Loi Bertrand) requires disclosure of HCP payments/transfers of value
Anti-gift law restricts certain types of HCP engagement tracking
Garante per la protezione dei dati personali has additional marketing consent requirements
AIFA regulations on pharmaceutical rep interactions require specific visit logging

migration_notes: When migrating from any source platform to target: (1) Consent records MUST be migrated with original consent dates, (2) Opt-out records are as important as opt-in records, (3) Consent granularity must match or exceed source platform (cannot consolidate separate channel consents into a single record), (4) Document the migration as a data processing activity in your Article 30 records.
